parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: bucket_name
parameters.description: The name of the bucket that contains the object.

parameters.name: ceph
parameters.description: Enable API compatibility with Ceph RGW. It takes into account the S3 API subset working with Ceph in order to provide the same module behaviour where possible. Requires endpoint_url if ceph=true. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: dualstack
parameters.description: Enables Amazon S3 Dual-Stack Endpoints, allowing S3 communications using both IPv4 and IPv6. Support for passing dualstack and endpoint_url at the same time has been deprecated, the dualstack endpoints are automatically configured using the configured region. Support will be removed in a release after 2024-12-01. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: S3 URL endpoint for usage with Ceph, Eucalyptus and fakes3 etc. Otherwise assumes AWS.

parameters.name: marker
parameters.description: Specifies the Object key to start with. Object keys are returned in alphabetical order, starting with key after the marker in order.

parameters.name: max_keys
parameters.description: Max number of results to return. Set this if you want to retrieve only partial results.

parameters.name: object_details
parameters.description: Retrieve requested S3 object detailed information.

parameters.name: object_name
parameters.description: The name of the object. If not specified, a list of all objects in the specified bucket will be returned. Mutually exclusive with prefix.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Limits the response to keys that begin with the specified prefix. Mutually exclusive with object_name.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Note: These examples do not set authentication details, see the AWS Guide for details.

- name: Retrieve a list of objects in S3 bucket
  amazon.aws.s3_object_info:
    bucket_name: MyTestBucket

- name: Retrieve a list of objects in Ceph RGW S3
  amazon.aws.s3_object_info:
    bucket_name: MyTestBucket
    ceph: true
    endpoint_url: "http://localhost:8000"

- name: Retrieve object metadata without object itself
  amazon.aws.s3_object_info:
    bucket_name: MyTestBucket
    object_name: MyTestObjectKey

- name: Retrieve detailed S3 information for all objects in the bucket
  amazon.aws.s3_object_info:
    bucket_name: MyTestBucket
    object_details:
      object_acl: true
      object_attributes: true
      attributes_list:
        - ETag
        - ObjectSize
        - StorageClass

- name: Retrieve detailed S3 object information
  amazon.aws.s3_object_info:
    bucket_name: MyTestBucket
    object_name: MyTestObjectKey
    object_details:
      object_acl: true
      object_tagging: true
      object_legal_hold: true
      object_attributes: true
      attributes_list:
        - ETag
        - ObjectSize

- name: Retrieve keys that begin with the prefix /my/desired/
  amazon.aws.s3_object_info:
    bucket: mybucket
    prefix: /my/desired/

return_values.name: object_info
return_values.description: S3 object details. Returned: when bucket_name and object_name are specified.

return_values.name: object_acl
return_values.description: Access control list (ACL) of an object. Returned: when object_details.object_acl=true.

return_values.name: grants
return_values.description: A list of grants. Returned: always

return_values.name: grantee
return_values.description: The entity being granted permissions. Returned: always

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: The canonical user ID of the grantee. Returned: always Sample: "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: type of grantee. Returned: always Sample: "CanonicalUser"

return_values.name: permission
return_values.description: Specifies the permission given to the grantee. Returned: always Sample: "FULL CONTROL"

return_values.name: owner
return_values.description: Bucket owner’s display ID and name. Returned: always

return_values.name: display_name
return_values.description: Bucket owner’s display name. Returned: always Sample: "abcd"

return_values.name: object_attributes
return_values.description: Object attributes. Returned: when object_details.object_attributes=true.

return_values.name: checksum
return_values.description: The checksum or digest of the object. Returned: always

return_values.name: checksum_crc32
return_values.description: The base64-encoded, 32-bit CRC32 checksum of the object. Returned: if it was upload with the object. Sample: "xxxxxxxxxxxx"

return_values.name: checksum_crc32c
return_values.description: The base64-encoded, 32-bit CRC32C checksum of the object. Returned: if it was upload with the object. Sample: "xxxxxxxxxxxx"

return_values.name: checksum_sha1
return_values.description: The base64-encoded, 160-bit SHA-1 digest of the object. Returned: if it was upload with the object. Sample: "xxxxxxxxxxxx"

return_values.name: checksum_sha256
return_values.description: The base64-encoded, 256-bit SHA-256 digest of the object. Returned: if it was upload with the object. Sample: "xxxxxxxxxxxx"

return_values.name: etag
return_values.description: An ETag is an opaque identifier assigned by a web server to a specific version of a resource found at a URL. Returned: always Sample: "8fa34xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx35c6f3b"

return_values.name: last_modified
return_values.description: The creation date of the object. Returned: always Sample: "2022-08-10T01:11:03+00:00"

return_values.name: object_parts
return_values.description: A collection of parts associated with a multipart upload. Returned: always

return_values.name: is_truncated
return_values.description: Indicates whether the returned list of parts is truncated. Returned: always

return_values.name: max_parts
return_values.description: The maximum number of parts allowed in the response. Returned: always

return_values.name: next_part_number_marker
return_values.description: When a list is truncated, this element specifies the last part in the list As well as the value to use for the PartNumberMarker request parameter in a subsequent request. Returned: always

return_values.name: part_number_marker
return_values.description: The marker for the current part. Returned: always

return_values.name: total_parts_count
return_values.description: The total number of parts. Returned: always

return_values.name: object_size
return_values.description: The size of the object in bytes. Returned: alwayS Sample: 819

return_values.name: parts
return_values.description: A container for elements related to an individual part. Returned: always

return_values.name: part_number
return_values.description: The part number identifying the part. This value is a positive integer between 1 and 10,000. Returned: always

return_values.name: size
return_values.description: The size of the uploaded part in bytes. Returned: always

return_values.name: storage_class
return_values.description: The storage class information of the object. Returned: always Sample: "STANDARD"

return_values.name: object_data
return_values.description: A dict containing the metadata of S3 object. Returned: when bucket_name and object_name are specified but object_details is not specified.

return_values.name: accept_ranges
return_values.description: Indicates that a range of bytes was specified. Returned: always

return_values.name: content_length
return_values.description: Size of the body (object data) in bytes. Returned: always

return_values.name: content_type
return_values.description: A standard MIME type describing the format of the object data. Returned: always

return_values.name: e_tag
return_values.description: A opaque identifier assigned by a web server to a specific version of a resource found at a URL. Returned: always

return_values.name: metadata
return_values.description: A map of metadata to store with the object in S3. Returned: always

return_values.name: server_side_encryption
return_values.description: The server-side encryption algorithm used when storing this object in Amazon S3. Returned: always

return_values.name: tag_count
return_values.description: The number of tags, if any, on the object. Returned: always

return_values.name: object_legal_hold
return_values.description: Object’s current legal hold status Returned: when object_details.object_legal_hold=true and object legal hold is set on the bucket.

return_values.name: legal_hold
return_values.description: The current legal hold status for the specified object. Returned: always

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Indicates whether the specified object has a legal hold in place. Returned: always Sample: "ON"

return_values.name: object_lock_configuration
return_values.description: Object Lock configuration for a bucket. Returned: when object_details.object_lock_configuration=true and object lock configuration is set on the bucket.

return_values.name: object_lock_enabled
return_values.description: Indicates whether this bucket has an Object Lock configuration enabled. Returned: always

return_values.name: rule
return_values.description: Specifies the Object Lock rule for the specified object. Returned: always

return_values.name: default_retention
return_values.description: The default Object Lock retention mode and period that you want to apply to new objects placed in the specified bucket. Returned: always

return_values.name: days
return_values.description: The number of days that you want to specify for the default retention period. Returned: always

return_values.name: mode
return_values.description: The default Object Lock retention mode you want to apply to new objects placed in the specified bucket. Must be used with either Days or Years. Returned: always

return_values.name: years
return_values.description: The number of years that you want to specify for the default retention period. Returned: always

return_values.name: object_retention
return_values.description: Object’s retention settings. Returned: when object_details.object_retention=true and object retention is set on the bucket.

return_values.name: retention
return_values.description: The container element for an object’s retention settings. Returned: always

return_values.name: retain_until_date
return_values.description: The date on which this Object Lock Retention will expire. Returned: always

return_values.name: object_tagging
return_values.description: The tag-set of an object Returned: when object_details.object_tagging=true.

return_values.name: s3_keys
return_values.description: List of object keys. Returned: when only bucket_name is specified and object_name, object_details are not specified. Sample: ["prefix1/", "prefix1/key1", "prefix1/key2"]
